name: Abuse
overview: Scripture clearly condemns violence and abuse, emphasizing that the Lord hates those who love violence and wickedness. Husbands are called to love their wives without bitterness, and fathers are instructed not to provoke or discourage their children but to nurture them with godly care. The removal of scorners and contentious behavior is encouraged to bring peace, highlighting the importance of maintaining love and respect within family relationships. These teachings address various forms of abuse, including domestic, marital, child, and substance-related abuses, calling believers to live by the fruit of the Spirit rather than works of the flesh.
